DSA File Integrity Verifier (Version 3)
========================================

A modern, standalone desktop tool for cryptographic file integrity verification
using the Digital Signature Algorithm (DSA) and SHA-256 digests.

Quick Start:
1. Double-click "DSA_Verifier.exe" to launch.
2. No Python installation or extra dependencies required.

Features:
- 2048-bit DSA Key Generation (with optional PKCS#8 passphrase protection)
- File Signing with SHA-256 digests and manifest generation (.sig & .sig.info)
- Verification & Tamper Detection (instant alert on any byte modification)
- Persistent Audit Verification History with real-time search/filter
- Ultra-smooth responsive modern UI
